issues: The draft fails to apply Rule R6 despite the Network specialist identifying a shared device profile ('Windows |  | chrome 66.0 | ') across 266 cards, including C01433-K1, C06940-K1, and C09657-K2.
The draft fails to include FILE_REPORT and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS in the actions as required by Rule R6 for shared origin across cards.
The draft fails to file a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Section 3a, which is required when fraud is strongly suspected and a shared device profile is involved.
events.what_would_change_verdict: Applying Rule R6 by naming the shared device profile, adding FILE_REPORT and MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS to the final actions, and filing a SAR under Section 3a.
